shots.detail_en: Morning: Man Cang's father steadies his loose old false teeth in a chipped mirror, smiling a tooth-gap smile.
shots.sub: 满仓爹：等长虹的钱回来，爹先装口新牙——咬得动排骨！
shots.speaker: MANCANG

shots.detail_en: At the dinner table Man Cang ladles soup for his father; the old man pushes the passbook over.
shots.sub: 满仓爹：利息不急。爹这辈子没戴过金镯子——回头去你娘坟前，供一个。
shots.speaker: MANCANG

shots.detail_en: Man Cang grins foolishly, but his eyes rim red.
shots.sub: 满仓：爹，别老提钱。钱是身外之物——您儿子连身家都全仓过，怕什么！
shots.speaker: MANCANG

shots.detail_en: Changhong's office: a repayment screen open — 'Lu -> Wang's father 60,000' pending confirm — his finger hovering above Enter.
Just before the finger lands, a red corner alert of abnormal Xiong-faction movement pops on the big screen (abstract warning); the finger withdraws.
shots.sub: ……再滚一仗。赢了，十倍还。
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: Transfer cancelled; the sixty thousand stays inside the capital pool.
shots.sub: 旁白：六万块，在 K 线里连根毫毛都不算——可毫毛底下，压着一口人的牙口。
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: Brokerage archive room: Hongli, hugging a stack of old ledgers, blocks Changhong's way.
shots.sub: 红：坐一分钟。你的账我替你看了十年——今天，替一个人问你一句话。
shots.speaker: RED

shots.detail_en: Blast point: Hongli slaps a capital-flow chart on the desk — the arrow of the sixty thousand stabs into the 'guarding pool'.
shots.sub: 红：这笔钱在打仗。它的主人——知道吗？
shots.speaker: RED

shots.detail_en: Changhong silently smooths the chart flat.
shots.sub: 长：三天后它回家，带着利息。 红：账目不会说谎——人也别学。
shots.speaker: CH+RED

shots.detail_en: Hongli stares at the pocket watch chain on his cuff.
shots.sub: 红：这表慢一分钟。你父亲拿它记什么，你拿它记什么？
shots.speaker: RED

shots.detail_en: Changhong hugs the notebook tighter and walks past her.
shots.sub: 长：打完这一仗，我连本带人，一起还。
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: War-prep montage: Changhong drawing deployment symbols / the alliance gathering / Man Cang firing off pager messages / red screen countdown (all details abstracted).
shots.sub: 旁白：这一仗要赢三样——本金、档案，和一面我不敢照的镜子。
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: Lianhua server room: Xiong Wei's screen wall reduces Changhong's betting path into a single curve.
shots.sub: 熊伟：主力路径拟合度 97%。但第 48 笔——方差异常。
shots.speaker: XIONGWEI

shots.detail_en: Screen zooms into trade No.48: an anomalous red dot glowing faintly inside the curve (amount masked).
shots.sub: 熊伟：一笔会『哭』的钱。情感权重，标红。
shots.speaker: XIONGWEI

shots.detail_en: Xiong Wei creates a new folder named 'Achilles', and drags the red dot into it.
shots.sub: 熊伟：模型结论：冷的人才有手。他这一笔，是露出来的喉咙。
shots.speaker: XIONGWEI

shots.detail_en: Rooftop at night: Changhong checks the watch against his phone — for the first time ever, they match exactly.
shots.sub: 表……走准了？
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: The watch chain lies in his palm; on the dark glass half of the reflection is his own face, the other half resembles another silhouette (mirror-abyss hint).
shots.sub: 旁白：慢一分钟，是提醒我市场快我一步。走准了——是我开始追它了。
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: Next day close: the whole board flushes red, alliance accounts turn green with profit; the crowd erupts.
shots.sub: 满仓：红了红了！全仓的兄弟们——今天加鸡腿！
shots.speaker: MANCANG

shots.detail_en: Changhong looks at the red numbers without a smile; the repayment screen halts on the confirm key once more.
shots.sub: ……还差最后一口档案。
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: In the VIP box, Xiong Tiancheng watches the board, Buddha beads turning slowly.
shots.sub: 熊：赢了钱，却不急着还钱。市场惩罚的是贪婪的人——可没人说过，惩罚之前，不先喂饱它。
shots.speaker: XIONG

shots.detail_en: Outside the brokerage, Man Cang's father watches Changhong's back through the glass, doesn't go in, stubs out his cigarette.
shots.sub: 满仓爹：别打扰他。先生忙着呢……忙，是好事。
shots.speaker: MANCANG

shots.detail_en: Black frame end card for next episode.
shots.sub: 那笔钱在账上长大——而给它起名『软肋』的人，已经出手。
shots.card: 那笔钱在账上长大——而给它起名『软肋』的人，已经出手。
